sources.title: Deep-Learning the Landscape

evidence.text: Implement explicit feed-forward multilayer perceptrons in Mathematica using linear layers, logistic sigmoid and tanh activations, and scalar-sum or vector-output layers. A common geometry architecture uses linear layers of widths 1000 and 100; training typically allows up to 1000 rounds.

sources.title: Calabi-Yau Spaces in the String Landscape

evidence.text: Particle spectra are computed through bundle cohomology, with cubic Yukawa couplings represented by suitable trilinear cohomology maps. The computational discussion includes exact-sequence calculations and supervised neural-network/SVM prediction from configuration matrices.

sources.title: String Model Building, Reinforcement Learning and Genetic Algorithms

evidence.text: RL changes one B integer by ±1 and a C integer in the same row by the same amount, preserving c1(V)=0. Rewards use score improvement, step/boundary penalties and a terminal bonus. REINFORCE and actor–critic use fully connected networks, typically width 64 and depth four.

sources.title: Physics as Code: From Scans to Theorems with ITP APIs in $SU(5)$ Model Building

evidence.text: Construct minimal top-Yukawa witnesses from an allowed Higgs-up entry and a neutral pair of 10 charges. Minimality is under deletion of stored charge data; repeated use of one 10 charge is represented by a singleton set.

sources.title: Deep-Learning the Landscape

evidence.text: Encode configurations as integer vectors or fixed-size zero-padded matrices: CICY threefolds use 12×15 arrays and fourfolds 16×20 arrays. Pixelation is a visualization device; the geometry experiments use no convolutional networks, and flattened CICY vectors are also reported to work.

sources.title: Deep-Learning the Landscape

evidence.text: Train on complete datasets or partial samples, then count rounded-output discrepancies against known answers. Learning curves vary the training fraction; several evaluations use the full original dataset. A normalized dot product is also reported as a measure of fit.

evidence.text: Integrate the dimensionless scalar in ln a, using algebraic density and equation-of-state relations to remove explicit H_0 and potential normalization. Applicability requires a matter-plus-scalar background and resolution of the printed coefficient discrepancy.

sources.title: Further refining the de Sitter swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Bound the gradient power below and curvature above, combine them with positive a, and cancel n′/n. In this paper the cancellation works algebraically, but its curvature input does not follow from the stated assumptions as presently rendered.

evidence.text: Include spinodal configurations missing from a single-vacuum expansion and follow the potential toward zero energy scale. The paper describes the expected flattening qualitatively; it supplies no flow equation, regulator, numerical procedure, or error estimate.

evidence.text: Which scalar trajectories satisfy the adopted quantum-gravity conjectures? The paper imposes an order-one excursion limit and a slope-or-negative-curvature condition, using the slope branch to test inflation on a positive linear potential.

evidence.text: Are the sampled critical points compatible with the Refined dS conjecture when compared through critical-point potential values and the smallest Hessian eigenvalue? The supplied paragraph only initiates this diagnostic.

sources.title: Non-canonical kinetic structures in the swampland

evidence.text: Can a conjectured restriction on sigma-model potentials constrain scalar actions with nonquadratic derivative dependence? The paper asks this for P(φ,X), where X = −(∂φ)²/2, and introduces an auxiliary-field extension to apply the geometric criterion.

sources.title: Is the trans-Planckian censorship a swampland conjecture?

evidence.text: Do ordinary scalar potentials contain positive stationary configurations that defeat universal censorship? Higgs, meson, and axion examples connect this question to particle physics.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and the Swampland

evidence.text: What curvature restriction follows for a quadratic hilltop over a specified fractional drop in positive potential? The setting fixes the maximum V0, constant negative curvature, and endpoint potential c_qV0.

sources.title: The web of swampland conjectures and the TCC bound

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravity consistency constrain the slope of a positive scalar potential? The reviewed TCC formulation assigns a specific dimension-dependent coefficient to an asymptotic exponential bound.

sources.title: From Swampland to Phenomenology and Back

evidence.text: Do familiar low-energy scalar potentials contain positive-energy stationary points incompatible with the original de Sitter proposal? The paper uses the Higgs potential and a conditional axion potential as examples.
